name: Hidden Grove
description: Find four words hidden along straight lines in a leafy letter grid.
rules: Tap the first and last letter of a word. Lines can run horizontally, vertically or diagonally, in either direction.
Find all four listed words. A wrong line costs 10 points. Tap the same square to cancel.
Use Tab and Enter, or arrow keys within the grid. No dragging or timer.
controls: Tap endpoints; arrows move focus; Enter selects.

name: One Letter Away
description: Bridge two words, changing just one letter at each step.
rules: Change exactly one letter to make a word in the open notebook. All words have four letters.
Reach the target from the starting word. The notebook is the complete allowed vocabulary for this puzzle.
Submit by typing and Enter. Undo a step if you take a detour. Invalid steps cost 10 points.
controls: Type four letters and Enter; Undo steps.

name: Last Letter
description: Guess a hidden word before six little leaves fall.
rules: Read the clue, then choose letters to uncover a hidden word.
Correct letters fill every matching position. A wrong letter costs one of six leaves. Repeating a guess is free.
Reveal the whole word to win. Six wrong letters end the round and reveal the answer.

name: Crossings
description: Fill three across clues and the down word that ties them together.
rules: Fill the white squares from four clues. Three across entries share letters with one down entry.
Type a letter in each square. Arrow keys move through the board; Tab visits white squares.
Check the completed grid. Correct letters turn green; wrong checks cost 10 points.
controls: Type letters; arrows move; Check grid.

name: Wordbreak
description: Find the spaces hiding inside a run of letters.
rules: Tap between letters to place or remove word boundaries.
Restore the sentence described by the clue. Capitalization and punctuation are already stripped away.
Check your spaces. Solve three phrases; wrong checks cost 10 points.
controls: Tap boundaries; Tab and Enter toggle.

name: Secret Post
description: Decode a letter-substitution message, one shared symbol at a time.
rules: Every cipher letter always stands for the same plain letter. Spaces are already in place.
Select a cipher tile, then a letter from the keyboard. All copies change together; each plain letter can map only once.
Check the message or ask for a revealed letter. Hints cost 20 points; wrong checks cost 10.
controls: Select cipher tile, type or tap letter; Backspace clears.

name: Center Letter
description: Build five clue words around one indispensable letter.
rules: Use only the displayed letters. Letters may repeat, but the green center letter must appear in every word.
Find the five curated clue answers. This small puzzle dictionary contains exactly these five words.
Type a word and press Enter. Duplicate answers are free; other invalid guesses cost 10 points.
controls: Type words and Enter; five clue answers.

name: Odd Company
description: Read the relationship and find the word that does not belong.
rules: Four words share a page; only three fit the stated relationship.
Choose the exception. A wrong choice stays on the page for another try and costs 10 points.
Solve three groups. Each reveal explains the distinction.
controls: Tap a word or Tab and Enter.

name: Alphabet Trail
description: Trace A to Y through an unbroken neighboring path.
rules: Start at A and visit B, C and onward to Y. Move only one square horizontally or vertically.
Every letter is used once. Diagonal or out-of-order moves cost 10 points without changing your path.
Undo your last step if needed. Arrow keys move focus; Enter chooses a square.
controls: Tap cells; arrows and Enter; Undo.

name: Sentence Studio
description: Reassemble a familiar saying from shuffled whole-word slips.
rules: Tap whole words to reconstruct the familiar saying named by the clue.
The capitalized first word and punctuated last word help frame the sentence. Tap an arranged word to return it.
Check your saying. Solve three; wrong checks cost 10 points.
controls: Tap word slips; Tab and Enter; Clear.

name: Compound Works
description: Join two halves into four everyday compound words.
rules: Choose a word from the left, then its partner from the right.
Every half is used once. Find the four familiar closed compound words for this set.
Correct pairs stay joined. Wrong pairs reset your selection and cost 10 points.
controls: Choose left then right; Tab and Enter.

name: Rhyme Lines
description: Match words by their ending sound, not their spelling.
rules: Choose a word on the left and its rhyming partner on the right.
Use ordinary English pronunciation. Every word belongs to exactly one pair in this set.
Find four pairs. Wrong matches reset selection and cost 10 points.
controls: Choose left then right; Tab and Enter.

name: Vowel Weather
description: Bring the missing vowels back to three clue words.
rules: Consonants stay in place. Every blank needs A, E, I, O or U.
Read the clue and type the whole restored word. Its consonants and length must match the pattern.
Restore three words. Wrong checks cost 10 points.
controls: Type the complete word and Enter.

name: Chain Reaction
description: Thread six words together by their first and last letters.
rules: The starting word is pinned. Choose a remaining word that begins with the last letter of the chain.
Use all six words once. Only the first and last letters matter.
Undo to escape a dead end. Invalid joins cost 10 points.
controls: Tap next word; Tab and Enter; Undo.

name: Proofreader
description: Spot the misspelled word and put the sentence right.
rules: Exactly one word in each sentence has a spelling mistake. Tap that word to edit it.
Type the correctly spelled replacement and submit. The other words are already correct.
Repair three sentences. Wrong selections or corrections cost 10 points.
